aspects.says: finally runs on every way out of its try: normal end, return, break, continue and an exception of any type, so cleanup written after the block or in one catch misses paths.
basis: section:finally Runs on Every Way Out of try: return, break, continue or a Throw

aspects.says: finally runs only when the thread leaves try: System.exit, SIGTERM, Runtime.halt, SIGKILL and JVM exit while a daemon thread is in try all skip it, while an interrupt does not.
basis: section:finally Runs Only When the Thread Leaves try: exit, halt and a Killed JVM Skip It

aspects.says: An exception thrown from finally replaces the exception in flight, with no cause or suppressed link to it, and ends the finally so later cleanup steps don't run.
basis: section:An Exception From finally Replaces the One in Flight and Skips the Cleanup After It

aspects.says: Each cleanup step that can fail gets its own try: its failure is added as suppressed to the one in flight or rethrown when there is none, and a lock is released in an inner finally.
basis: section:An Exception From finally Replaces the One in Flight and Skips the Cleanup After It

aspects.says: A finally that ends with return (or break, continue or its own throw) discards the try's pending exception or return value.
basis: section:A return in finally Throws Away the Exception and the try's Result

aspects.says: return passes a reference to the object, so finally that mutates the object (clear()) changes what the caller receives, while reassigning the variable does not.
basis: section:A return Fixes Its Value Before finally Runs, but the Object Can Still Change

aspects.says: The value a return statement returns is evaluated before finally runs, so changing a primitive field or variable in finally doesn't change the result.
basis: section:A return Fixes Its Value Before finally Runs, but the Object Can Still Change

aspects.says: javac compiles a return in finally without a warning unless -Xlint:finally is on.
basis: section:A return in finally Throws Away the Exception and the try's Result
aspects.reason: a compiler flag's diagnostic; the graded build compiles the reader's code with fixed options and no test can observe a warning
